root_text: China faces a rise in a new virus, Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV), with symptoms similar to COVID-19. Children under 2 are most affected, and it spreads through coughing & sneezing. While not as deadly as COVID, it lacks a vaccine.  #HMPV
